# Settlement-network reference fixtures

`county-policy-v1.json` freezes the translated `world_builder.py` policy used by
SN-0. Tests consume this repository-owned fixture; the original Downloads file is not
a runtime or test dependency.

The fixture deliberately records policy rather than legacy output IDs or random
dimensions. Current editor polygons, catalogue proxy footprints, UUIDs, validation,
preview, history, and export contracts remain authoritative.
